propositions: Pydantic AI must be authoritative for Agent turns, structured-output retries, fallback, usage limits, and instrumentation while Rebar retains policy for deterministic repair, provider safety, and failure taxonomy.
Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through a single Pydantic Agent operation within an approved shared request budget.
Retry context must preserve the complete failed response on proven fit and omit it whole otherwise; authoritative input, accepted output, and stored history must never truncate.
Rebar must preserve deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal/filter behavior, typed exhaustion, final-failure artifacts, and answering-model provenance.
Successful operations must report complete Pydantic run usage exactly once, while fallback/downgrade candidates remain trace or journal events rather than competing usage counters.
The bespoke structured-output retry loop must be removed only after the compatibility suite and authorized Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries pass.
